role: Declares the 1.7.10 GenLayer biome stack: the layer kinds, one layer node with its base and world seeds and parent links, the fixed-capacity stack with its genBiomes and voronoi outputs, and the area and biome-id queries.

structs.name: layer
structs.java: GenLayer (baseSeed, worldGenSeed, parent; GenLayerHills and GenLayerRiverMix second parent)

structs.name: layers
structs.java: WorldChunkManager.genBiomes and biomeIndexLayer, with every layer node

gpu: line 24, struct layer: p1 and p2 are pointers into the same node array (a pointer graph, though inside one fixed array of LAYER_MAX 64)
notes: The layer nodes live in a fixed array, so the parent pointers could become indices for the GPU. Used by terrain.h, village.c, populate.c, stronghold.c and temple.c.
